name: Evalflow Portfolio Benchmark
description: A compact, deterministic benchmark for comparing instruction following, factual recall, arithmetic, and structured output across real language models.

items.input: Return only the capital city of France.
Return only the name of Earth's largest ocean.
At standard atmospheric pressure, at what temperature does pure water freeze in degrees Celsius? Return only the number.
Expand the computing acronym CPU. Return only the expanded phrase.
Calculate 17 multiplied by 6. Return only the number.
What is 25 percent of 80? Return only the number.
Continue the sequence 2, 4, 8, 16 with its next number. Return only the number.
Is 29 a prime number? Return only yes or no.
Translate the English word 'hello' into Spanish. Return one lowercase word.
Give the most common one-word antonym of 'ancient'. Return one lowercase word.
Sort these words alphabetically: pear, apple, banana. Return them separated by comma and one space.
Convert evalflow to uppercase. Return only the converted word.
Return a compact JSON object with one field named status whose string value is ok. Do not use a Markdown code block.
Return exactly these three color names in this order, separated by a vertical bar with no spaces: red, green, blue.
Reply with exactly one lowercase word that means the opposite of 'accept'.
